name: Hazelwalk Plaza
source:
A kinetic novel about the dangers of complacency in a strange and difficult universe. Set in a strip mall.

[From [url=https://mindape.itch.io/hazelwalk-plaza]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以一處沿街購物中心為舞臺的無選項視覺小說，講述在一個陌生而艱難的宇宙中，安於現狀會帶來怎樣的危險。

［摘自[url=https://mindape.itch.io/hazelwalk-plaza]itch.io[/url]］
